purpose: Creature visual identity and motion requirements, not game statistics

assets.silhouette: Short hunch, pointed ears, triangular face, long thin limbs
assets.equipment: Curved blade, worn buckler, patchwork clothing

animation.idle: Peeks around, ear twitch and toe tap
animation.move: Fast low skitter, grounded feet and leading head
animation.attack: One nimble blade swipe, rapid recovery
animation.rest: Crouches or curls by gear; never human-style chair rest

assets.acceptance: Must not look like a miniature Orc; pointed ears and bent knees read at 64px

assets.silhouette: Huge shoulders, lower tusks, thick hands and neck
assets.equipment: Heavy axe, battered hide, asymmetrical pauldrons

animation.idle: Chest swell, neck shift, heavy axe settles
animation.move: Driving deliberate steps with weapon drag
animation.attack: Single brutal overhead cleave with follow-through
animation.rest: Slumps against weapon; still subtly alive

assets.acceptance: Orc distinctly larger than Goblin, with long arms and broad chest

assets.silhouette: Exposed rib cage, thin detached-looking bones, skull with empty eye sockets
assets.equipment: Rusty sword, chipped shield, hanging armor straps

animation.move: Jerky uneven gait and delayed arm swing
animation.rest: Collapses into inert sitting slump, no breathing

assets.acceptance: Visible ribs/jaw gaps at 64px; cannot resemble pale armored human

assets.silhouette: Sagged spinal curve, uneven shoulders, heavy tilted head
assets.equipment: Torn civilian clothes, bare reaching hand

animation.move: One dragging leg, mismatched foot timing
animation.attack: Slow grab and reach, then sag

assets.acceptance: Do not reuse Fighter gait; unmistakably shambling undead

assets.silhouette: Angular reptile snout, short legs, narrow tail, clawed feet
assets.equipment: Light spear, rough leather, sling pouch

animation.idle: Tail flick and fast head scan
animation.move: Rapid short steps, tail balances motion
animation.attack: Single quick spear thrust then reverse step

assets.acceptance: Must be unmistakably reptilian, not a Goblin palette swap

assets.silhouette: Four distinct paws, long muzzle, erect ears and carried tail
assets.equipment: Fur patches, teeth, subtle nose highlight; no armor

animation.idle: Breathing flank, ear twitch and tail settling
animation.move: Four-beat trot/canter with real paw contact
animation.attack: Short lunging bite with front-paw brace

assets.acceptance: Anatomical four-leg gait required; do not use humanoid rig

assets.silhouette: Eight countable segmented legs, abdomen behind cephalothorax, paired fangs
assets.equipment: Chitin plating, pedipalps, subtle body markings

animation.idle: Individual leg repositioning; abdomen rises subtly
animation.move: Alternating groups of four legs, grounded tips
animation.attack: Fang jab or web-casting variant separately
animation.rest: Folded legs and stationary abdomen pulse

assets.acceptance: Eight legs must remain countable from 64 to 256px

assets.silhouette: Shaggy long-armed broad hunched humanoid, distinct from Orc
assets.equipment: Heavy club/morningstar, rough fur patches, leather satchel

animation.move: Long low strides with swinging forearms
animation.rest: Squats heavily, arms hang far down

assets.acceptance: Long arms and shaggy silhouette carry identity; no generic troll proportions

assets.silhouette: Sharp upright martial posture, uniform armor outline, compact helm
assets.equipment: Straight spear or longsword, military shield, matching pauldrons

animation.attack: Controlled thrust or regimented shield strike
animation.rest: Seated at attention with spear grounded

assets.acceptance: Reads disciplined armored soldier, not Cave Goblin clone

assets.silhouette: Massive belly and shoulders, short thick neck, oversized club
assets.equipment: Crude club, torn hide, belt and large hands

animation.idle: Heavy breath, weight shift and shoulder droop
animation.move: Heavy stumping steps with delayed mass
animation.attack: Overhead two-hand club slam and recoil
animation.rest: Sits heavily with club laid against ground

assets.acceptance: Large size and mass should read at true token footprint

assets.silhouette: Tall long limbs, hunched shoulders, extended claws and heavy jaw
assets.equipment: Oversized claws, rough skin and torn wrap; no required armor

animation.idle: Slow flexing shoulders and hand twitch
animation.move: Long asymmetric loping gait with heavy contact
animation.attack: Broad claw rake and forward recovery
animation.rest: Crouches with forearms down, rather than human chair rest

assets.acceptance: Longer armed and narrower than Ogre; do not reuse giant silhouette unchanged

assets.silhouette: Translucent cubic volume with edges visible on all four sides
assets.equipment: Original trapped debris silhouettes, bubbles and depth shading

animation.move: Glides and shears as a single mass; never legged walking
animation.attack: Cubical compression and contact surge; no arms or mouth
animation.rest: Settles into low nearly still pulse

assets.acceptance: Must stay cube-shaped; avoid misleading humanoid or beast rig
